newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg/mark seen struggling back to 2.80.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg/mark seen struggling back to 2.80.

text.p: Sterling should struggle higher against the mark, attempting to pare some losses after sinking to 11-day lows of around 2.7915 marks on Tuesday, said analysts.

"For the short-term, it's 2.79-2.80 for a range. If we do get above 2.80 marks, watch for squeezes to 2.81, but generally I think the market will be very stretched above 2.80," said Brian Kiely, treasury technician at Royal Bank of Scotland.
At 0735 GMT sterling/mark was trading at 2.7975/85 against 2.7920/30 in late Europe on Monday.
But sterling, which scaled 4-1/2 year peaks of 2.8331 marks last week, is losing its impetus, said analysts.
